Name: WaterDrivenInfrastructure
Author: Jared
Description: Adds water-powered sawmills, forges, grinding mills, ore sluices, fishponds, and mill race outlets. Build large-scale infrastructure near rivers using water wheels and mill races. Mill Race Outlets provide a steady source of unclean water at any outdoor location — craft a Mill Race, build the outlet anywhere outside, and draw water freely (freezes in winter). Fully standalone (CSFFModFramework only) — ships its own copper AND iron rivets, solder, and cast sheets, with a Cast Iron Sheet that shears into eight Iron Rivets in one cold-work craft so both sheets stay useful with no other mod installed. AdvancedCopperTools is optional and, when installed, its copper/iron nails and copper/iron sheets are used interchangeably with WDI's own fasteners. Tested with EA 0.66.
